metadata.name: POC flappy episodes (active/inactive churn)
metadata.description: pending_count:0 + recovering_count:0 => every breach starts a NEW active episode and every recovery ends it immediately. Produces many short-lived episodes (distinct episode.id + reset episode.status_started_at).

breach.query: FROM kbn-data-forge-fake_hosts.fake_hosts-* | WHERE event.dataset == "system.cpu" | STATS avg_cpu = AVG(system.cpu.user.pct) BY host.name | WHERE avg_cpu > 80
